driver.name: Screwdriver set
driver.desc: Precision bits: Pentalobe P2, Tri-point Y000, Phillips #000 and Standoff.
driver.effect: Higher tiers: faster screwing, less risk of stripping screws and a wider torque window.

spudger.name: Spudger
spudger.desc: Anti-static pry tool for popping off flex cable connectors without scratching the board.
spudger.effect: Higher tiers: less risk of damaging connectors when you disconnect them.

pick.name: Opening picks
pick.desc: Thin picks you slide along the edges to slice through the screen adhesive.
pick.effect: Used to cut the perimeter adhesive: careful not to push them in too far where the flex cables run.

suction.name: Suction cup
suction.desc: Lifts the screen just enough to slip a pick in.
suction.effect: Higher tiers: grips even when the adhesive is cooler (6 °C and 12 °C less).

tweezers.name: Tweezers
tweezers.desc: For small, fragile parts and for pulling the battery's adhesive pull tabs.
tweezers.effect: Higher tiers: you can pull the tabs faster without snapping them, and you break fewer fragile parts.

heat.name: Heat source
heat.desc: Softens the adhesive on screens and glass before opening.
heat.effect: Higher tiers heat up faster; the heating plate warms evenly and never overheats.

brush.name: Anti-static brush
brush.desc: Sweeps sand and dust off the components.

toothpick.name: Toothpick
toothpick.desc: The cheapest and most effective tool for lint in the charging port.
toothpick.effect: Cleans the charging port from the outside, without opening the phone.

ipa.name: 99% isopropyl alcohol
ipa.desc: Dissolves corrosion and salt residue and evaporates without a trace.
ipa.effect: Essential for seawater corrosion and for freeing batteries whose pull tabs have snapped.

air.name: Compressed air
air.desc: Blows sand out of the corners the brush can't reach.
air.effect: Clears dirt faster than the brush; the compressor is quicker still.

card.name: Plastic card
card.desc: A stiff card to slide under the battery so you can pry it up safely.
card.effect: Lets you free a battery with snapped pull tabs without using the spudger.

adhesive.name: Adhesive seals
adhesive.desc: Pre-cut adhesives for closing up the screen and battery just like the factory did.
adhesive.effect: Restores water resistance on closing: customers appreciate it in their reviews (even more with the Pro tier).

extractor.name: Screw extractor
extractor.desc: Rescues screws with a stripped head.
extractor.effect: Without it, one stripped screw stalls the whole repair.

flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: For hunting down screws that rolled off the bench.

esd.name: Anti-static protection
esd.desc: Grounds static electricity before it reaches the chips.
esd.effect: Cuts random electrical damage by 40% (wrist strap) or 65% (full kit).
esd.t2: ESD kit with gloves and mat

mat.name: Magnetic mat
mat.desc: Magnetic grid with numbered cells: a place for every screw.
mat.effect: More cells: 8, 15 or 24. Screws on the mat don't roll away and don't get mixed up.

multimeter.name: Measuring instruments
multimeter.desc: They measure the current the phone draws: the first clue in every diagnosis.
multimeter.effect: The USB tester shows the amps while charging; the bench power supply reveals logic board faults.

battester.name: Battery tester
battester.desc: Reads the battery's health and charge cycles.
battester.effect: During diagnosis it instantly tells a worn-out battery from a dead or swollen one.

programmer.name: Chip programmer
programmer.desc: Copies the calibration data from the original part to the new one.
programmer.effect: Preserves True Tone and calibrations when you replace paired displays, batteries and cameras.

ultrasonic.name: Ultrasonic bath
ultrasonic.desc: Microbubbles lift corrosion and dirt, even from under the chips.
ultrasonic.effect: Fully cleans a removed component in one go (not batteries or displays).

solder.name: Soldering
solder.desc: For micro-soldering jobs on the logic board.
solder.effect: Together with the microscope, it lets you repair charging chips and burnt connectors.

microscope.name: Stereo microscope
microscope.desc: Magnifies the logic board until you can see the individual pads.
microscope.effect: Unlocks the microscope view, required for micro-soldering.

separator.name: Separator machine
separator.desc: Separates the broken glass from a display's still-good panel.
separator.effect: Refurbishes a broken display into a “Good” spare part, a couple of times a day.

chair.name: Seating
chair.desc: After hours at the bench, your back sends you the bill.
chair.effect: Higher tiers: tiredness adds fewer mistakes.

fan.name: Cooling
fan.desc: Between 11 am and 3 pm the heat makes your hands sweat.
fan.effect: The fan halves heat-related mistakes; the air conditioner eliminates them.

lamp.name: Bench lamp
lamp.effect: The magnifying lamp halves mistakes caused by poor light after sunset.

lights.name: Shop lights
lights.desc: Fairy lights and spotlights that warm up the mood when the sun goes down.
lights.effect: More atmosphere (more customers and tips) and fewer mistakes in the evening.

rack.name: Phone rack
rack.desc: The slots where waiting phones are kept.

shelf.name: Parts shelves
shelf.desc: More room to keep spare parts in stock.
shelf.effect: Raises storage capacity from 14 to 40 parts.
